items.title: 32.8 Effect of Climate Change on Crops (climate change ka fasalon par asar) (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 32.8, printed pages 236-237 (PDF 239-240).

blocks.text: Climate change (mausam ki lambi tabdeeli) se sab se zyada khatra agriculture (kheti) ko hai. Climate change ki wajah se temperature, precipitation (barish) aur extreme weather events (shadeed mausam ke waqiat) mein tabdeeli seedha kheti par asar dalti hai. Heat stress (garmi ka dabao) paude mein dehydration (paani ki kami) karta hai, jis se aakhir photosynthesis aur respiration (saans) dono kamzor ho jaate hain. Zyada temperature paude ka metabolism tez kar sakta hai, lekin agar garmi had se barh jaye to paude heat stress ka shikaar ho jaate hain aur un ki barhotri aur paidawar kam ho jaati hai. Isi tarah sard mausam bhi kuch fasalon ko nuqsan deta hai; yeh chhote paudon ke liye jaan-leva hai aur poori fasal zaya ho sakti hai.

Aam barish paudon ko sehatmand barhotri ke liye kaafi paani aur nutrients deti hai. Lekin rainfall patterns (barish ke andaaz) badal jayein to kuch ilaqon mein drought (khushk-saali) aur kuch mein floods (selaab) aa sakte hain, aur dono se crop failure (fasal ki tabahi) ho sakti hai. Unpredictable (be-waqt) barish aur cloud burst (badal phatna) soil erosion (mitti ka bahna) karte hain aur nutrients se bhari oopar wali mitti (top soil) baha le jaate hain.

Hurricanes (samundari toofan), heatwaves (garmi ki lehrein) aur ole (hailstorms) fasalein aur agricultural infrastructure (kheti ka dhancha) tabah kar sakte hain, jis se food shortage (khuraak ki kami) ho jaati hai. Toofan paude jar se ukhaar dete hain aur shaakhein tor dete hain. Tez hawayein paani ki kami aur drought la sakti hain. Ole patton, phalon aur tanon ko nuqsan dete hain, tissues toot jaate hain aur photosynthesis kamzor ho jata hai. Shadeed ole poori fasal tabah kar ke saari paidawar khatam kar sakte hain. Zyada UV-index (suraj ki UV roshni kitni tez hai) aur heatwaves fasal par sakht heat stress dalti hain, paani tezi se urta hai aur patte jal bhi sakte hain.

In tabdeeliyon ke mutabiq dhalne ke liye scientists nayi fasalon ki aisi qismein (varieties) bana rahe hain jo mukhtalif mausam behtar bardasht kar sakein (resilient), maslan drought-resistant corn (khushk-saali bardasht karne wali makai) ya heat-tolerant wheat (garmi bardasht karne wali gandum). Drought tolerant aur flood-proof traits (khoobiyan) bhi banayi gayi hain. Maslan “Sub1 rice” do hafte tak paani mein doobe reh kar bhi zinda reh sakta hai.

blocks.prompt: Climate change fasal ki paidawar kam karne ke do tareeqe batayein.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi do: heat stress aur paani ki kami; badli hui barish se drought ya floods; badal phatne se top soil ka bahna; toofan, ole ya heatwaves se tabahi; sardi se chhote paudon ki maut.

items: Garmi, sardi, drought, floods, toofan aur ole paidawar ghatate hain.
Heat stress: dehydration, kamzor photosynthesis, kam yield.
Nayi qismein: drought-resistant corn, heat-tolerant wheat, Sub1 rice (do hafte paani mein zinda).
